name: FRZRMTN
notes: Frazier Mountain Internet Service (FMIS) is a fixed wireless ISP serving residential and small-business subscribers in the Pine Mountain Club / Frazier Park area of Kern County, California. We are a small eyeball network with heavy inbound traffic ratio. Our routes are RPKI-signed (valid ROAs for all announced prefixes) and IRR-registered with ARIN. We maintain an open peering policy and welcome settlement-free peering, particularly at any regional exchange point serving Southern California. For peering requests or network coordination, please use the NOC or Technical contacts listed above; for abuse reports, use the Abuse contact.
